description: Creates a runnable first-draft flow from a spec you author: pick the simplest pattern that fits (classifier for read-and-bucket, structurer for transform/extract/draft-for-review, agent for genuinely conversational), write a production-quality system prompt grounded in what the user told you, and mark anything stubbed with [STUB: ...] markers plus stubNotes. The draft opens in Workbench's simple editor at /w/<workspace>/flows/<id> — give the user that path. May return `needs_confirmation`; show the user what you're proposing and wait for their approval, then re-call with the approvalId. When the draft comes from a Compass change, pass its opportunityId so the flow and the change point at each other (Compass shows 'Open in Workbench'; the flow shows where it came from). Then: workbench_flows_run to try it, workbench_flows_publish when it's ready for schedules and share links.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

categories.description: classifier only: 2-12 buckets. The classifier asks the systemPrompt as one pick-one question with these as the options, and returns `values.category` plus `answers.category` (probabilities and confidence).

description.description: 1-2 sentences: what it does, where it fits.

inputDescription.description: What the flow's single input carries.

mode.description: Pattern editor the draft opens in. Pick interviewer for conversations that LEARN something from a person (research calls, intake, retros) — pair it with workbench_flows_share_create so non-account humans can talk to it.

model.description: The model node slug the draft runs on, from workbench_node_catalog_get, that the workspace allows. For a classifier, a `decision` entry (Jev, Kev, Solar Decide); defaults to TypeSafe: Jev Latest. Otherwise an `llm` entry (e.g. an OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google model); defaults to Claude Haiku 4.5. Set it here rather than editing the flow afterwards.

opportunityId.description: Compass change (from compass_opportunities_list) this draft implements. Sets the flow ↔ change link; refused when the change already has a draft.

responseSchemaJson.description: structurer only: the output JSON Schema, JSON-encoded as a string (object root, required fields, additionalProperties false).

stubNotes.description: What's stubbed / missing / worth wiring next.

systemPrompt.description: The draft's behavior — production-quality first attempt with [STUB: ...] / [FILL IN: ...] markers where reality is missing. Required for structurer and classifier. Leave it out of an agent to get the bare model with no instructions (a 'promptless' agent).

variables.description: agent / interviewer: types and descriptions for the {{tokens}} in systemPrompt. Every {{token}} becomes a variable on its own (the test pane and scenarios list it, the app fills it per user at run time); pass this only to set a type other than string or say what fills it.

description.description: What the app passes in, e.g. 'The member's first name, from the CRM'.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this.

name: workbench_flows_scaffold
title: Scaffold a first-draft Workbench flow
